steps.note: Add static grass with PVA Glue
Add weathering powder around rocks: Grey Ash/Dry Mud
Add debris and skulls and barbed wire
Pigment: Vallejo Rusty Pigment set around rocks
Thick coat over the whole base; press in a few small rocks or cork pieces first.
Patches of snow, thicker against rocks and the model's feet.
Leave a few channels between the rocks for the lava.
Thin lines in the very middle, where it is hottest.
Over the rock edges next to the lava, so they seem to glow.
Glue on bits of brick, plastic sprue offcuts or spare parts first as debris.
Pick out a few bricks; rust on metal debris with Ryza Rust.
Very light, on the highest grains.
Drag a cocktail stick through it for tracks and footprints.
In the deepest tracks, for wet puddles.
Dries with cracks; a thicker coat gives bigger cracks.
Glue static grass or tufts on the green patches with PVA; blow off the loose fibres when dry.
